errors.error_description: A single wire is driven by two continuous assignments on the same line, creating multiple active drivers and bus contention.
A built-in gate instance connects a scalar output to a vector input, causing a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
A deeply nested ternary expression drives a 32-bit debug signal, creating unnecessarily long combinational logic paths.
The empty flag uses 4-state equality (===) in synthesizable RTL, which is unsafe and non-synthesizable for hardware comparison.
